situations.title: Donbas Attrition and Deep Strike Campaign
situations.summary: High-intensity attritional warfare persists. Russia maintains localized offensives in the east, while Ukraine prioritizes long-range drone strikes against Russian energy infrastructure and logistics. Frontlines show marginal movement despite massive drone integration.

situations.title: Levant Cross-Border Escalation
situations.summary: Intensified rocket fire and targeted assassinations on the Israel-Lebanon border. Israel signals potential ground operations to establish a northern buffer zone, while Iran increases advanced missile shipments to regional proxies.

situations.title: South China Sea Maritime Confrontation
situations.summary: Frequent collisions and water cannon incidents near Sabina Shoal. China enforces restrictive maritime laws; the Philippines bolsters the 1951 Mutual Defense Treaty via expanded US rotational access and joint patrols.

situations.title: Sudanese Fragmented Conflict
situations.summary: Civil war remains deadlocked with severe humanitarian costs. Khartoum and Darfur are epicenter of urban combat. Foreign drone proliferation continues to fuel stalemate despite multiple failed international mediation attempts.

situations.title: Sahel Insurgency and Russian Realignment
situations.summary: Militant groups expand territory as Western forces exit. The Alliance of Sahel States (AES) relies heavily on Russian security assistance, leading to increased kinetic operations but deteriorating regional stability.

situations.title: Taiwan Strait Grey Zone Pressure
situations.summary: Persistent PRC military flights and large-scale cyberattacks targeting Taiwan's power grid. Beijing utilizes economic coercion and maritime 'law enforcement' patrols to erode Taipei’s sovereignty without triggering full-scale kinetic war.

situations.title: Eastern DRC M23 Insurgency
situations.summary: M23 rebels seize strategic hubs in North Kivu. Tensions between Kinshasa and Kigali reach critical levels amid mutual accusations of sovereignty violations. Regional peacekeeping efforts struggle to maintain buffer zones.
